observation.command:
cd /workspace/src/Bovis.Web
# Clean up my temporary probe artifacts (not part of the installation)
rm -rf /tmp/probe /tmp/pbin /tmp/bovis_validate_server.log
echo "cleaned my temp probe dirs"
echo "=== render with sid=new: body (no service exists yet -> expect NotFound/empty) ==="
curl -s -w "\nHTTP %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:5195/render?sid=new&format=png" | head -c 300
echo
echo "=== Confirm the running install is the documented one: process + port + log ==="
ps -o pid,cmd -p 1655
awk 'NR>1{split($2,a,":"); cmd="printf \"%d\\n\" 0x"a[2]; cmd|getline p; close(cmd); if($4=="0A") print "LISTEN port",p}' /proc/net/tcp | sort -u | grep 5195
echo "=== server log: key success lines ==="
grep -E "Now listening|Application started|connection to Bovis database established|Serving public files" /tmp/bovis_server.log
echo "=== confirm I did NOT modify appsource (git clean) ==="
cd /workspace && git status --short | head; echo "(git status end)"
